newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Gali files for 500,000 units.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Gali files for 500,000 units.

text.p: Gali Global Holdings Ltd filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commisson an initial public offering of up to 500,000 units, each consisting of two ordinary shares and one redeemable ordinary share purchase warrant.
The Israeli shoe manufacturer said it expects the units to sell at $12 each. The warrants have an exercise price of $6 each.
Underwriters for the offering, First Metropolitan Securities Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 75,000 units.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to repay outstanding bank debt, to upgrade and expand the company's retail shoe store chain, and for other general corporate needs.
After the offering, the company, with headquarters in Tel Aviv, will have three million ordinary shares outstanding.
In 1996, the company reported net income of $57,000, or three cents a share, on sales of $21 million. That compares to a net loss of $230,000, or 12 cents a share, on sales of $19.88 million in 1995.
